headings.text: Three threads from one crocus. Everything else follows.
What goes in the kitchen first
We do not sell masala. We keep it. In tins, in the dark, until the evening you finally cook the thing you have been meaning to.
“The Lakadong turmeric changed the colour of my dal and, I suspect, my mood. The tin alone makes the shelf look like a jeweller’s.”
“I have cooked with Kashmiri saffron for twenty years. This is the first Indian saffron I would put in front of a Persian guest without apologising.”
“A spice company that talks about harvest dates the way wineries talk about vintages. Finally.”

findings.message: 5 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Three threads from one crocus. Everything else f" → 3 lines (8 words, 123.8px); "We do not sell masala. We keep it. In tins, in t" → 3 lines (26 words, 69.1px, a paragraph set above 36px); "Heirloom Garam Masala" → 3 lines (3 words, 92.2px); "“The Lakadong turmeric changed the colour of my " → 3 lines (24 words, 51.8px, a paragraph set above 36px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 10 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 9 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Bestsellers" above "What goes in the kitchen first"; "Manifesto" above "We do not sell masala. We keep it. In ti"; "Shop the Vault" above "Twenty-six reasons to stay in."; "Combos" above "Sets, priced"; "Where it begins" above "Five pins."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "06", "01", "02", "03", "04"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 159 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Free shipping above ₹499", "Cash on delivery available", "Harvest 2026 has landed: Pampore saffron", "Single-origin · Harvest 2026 · Lot 26").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 41 gradient fill(s): div.hero__bg → radial-gradient(60% 50% at 70% 100%, rgba(122, 31, 26, 0.35), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 70%), radial-gradient(40% 40% a | div.hero__rays → conic-gradient(from 200deg at 85% -10%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0deg, rgba(232, 134, 42, 0.12) 10deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0 | section#bestsellers.best → linear-gradient(rgb(11, 9, 7), rgb(22, 18, 14))
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 4 text-shadow(s).
findings.fix: Remove; fix legibility with a scrim or a different crop.

findings.message: 22 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.announce 1440px | div.trust 1440px | dl.notes 520px | div 520px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 8 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 2 rows of identical boxed cards.
findings.fix: Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (text #efe6d4, text #efe5d4).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Cinzel, Manrope, Cormorant Garamond).
findings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 88 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (something lies over it).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: 2 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 640px at 11476px; 492px at 16360px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Three threads" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "from one crocus." (screen 1, 100% hidden); "Everything else follows." (screen 1, 100% hidden); "Six thousand threads. One name." (screen 2, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Large text is cut off along its top by the box that holds it: "Kashmiri" (screen 6); "Green" (screen 7)
findings.fix: Jurors read a wordmark sliced at the top as broken. Give the box room for the ascenders (line-height and padding), or crop at the bottom or a side edge on purpose.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "Three threads" (screen 1, 100% over a picture); "from one crocus." (screen 1, 100% over a picture); "Everything else follows." (screen 1, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 3 screens in a row: "Mongra Saffron"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.
